THE BOOK EVERYONE’S TALKING ABOUT

Do you really know the family next door?

‘Bloody brilliant!’ Bonnie’s Book Talk, 5 stars
‘Wow … one of my favourite reads this year!’ Goodreads reviewer, 5 stars
‘BOOM … What a twist … Fantastic.’ Goodreads reviewer, 5 stars

Melissa Sanderson is the perfect wife and mother. She dotes on her daughter, and lives in her dream home in a quiet cul-de-sac in the suburbs.

But looks can be deceiving. 

Something is amiss in that house – all the neighbours think so. Some say Melissa is having an affair. Others say she’s been drinking too much.

Then one night, sirens wake up the whole neighbourhood. 

Melissa Sanderson is dead.

AN ABSOLUTELY UNPUTDOWNABLE THRILLER WITH A BRILLIANT ENDING YOU WON’T SEE COMING – if you like Lisa Gardner, Robert Bryndza or Clare Mackintosh, Her Final Hour will keep you reading well into the night.

**Each Gina Harte book can be read as part of the series or as a standalone**

What readers are saying about Her Final Hour:
‘Straight off I’m going to say this is one of my Books of the Year. I was hooked from the first chapter… one hell of a twist at the end. The story starts off fast and just keeps going. I have used the phrase, “I couldn’t put it down” before… This one I really couldn’t put down.’ Nigel Adams Bookworm, 5 stars

‘I could not put it down until I’d finished it!! This book is definitely one that grips you from the first page and doesn’t let up the action until the very end.  A nail-biting, spine-tingling thriller of a book and I can’t wait to see what happens in book three!! Fantastic!!!’ Stardust Book Reviews, 5 stars

‘I finished this book in one sitting… you will want to know the ending and won't be able to put it down… Carla Kovach really knows how to bring the entire thing together with a heart pounding climax.’ Goodreads reviewer

‘This book had many twists and kept you reading into the night. I was so glad this book lived up to The Next Girl which was exceptional… I absolutely love this series.’ Goodreads reviewer

‘A compulsive plot and a killer twist at the end. …the novel had me turning the pages rapidly to see what was coming next.’ Goodreads reviewer

‘From the first page I literally couldn't stop turning the pages until I finished it. A fast paced thriller with builds suspense in a way that does not disappoint.’ Goodreads reviewer, 5 stars

‘You won't want to put it down. I read this book in 24 hours.’ Goodreads reviewer, 5 stars

‘I have found a new great series to follow! A well written, intriguing and fast paced read which would keep you on your toes till the last page!’ Goodreads reviewer, 5 stars

‘I couldn’t wait to get my hands on this!... This book is another amazing detective mystery and really hard to put down!’ Goodreads reviewer

‘I read book one in this series and loved it. I was so excited to get book two and .... it did not disappoint!! I did not want to put this book down until I finished it. Can't wait to read the next one.’ Goodreads reviewer
